alt: a Blender render of a glossy, crumpled surface, with red, yellow and blue worm-like shapes on a grey background. The background is split into 2 diagonally divided areas. It seems like something else is being reflected in the image (giving it a mysterious quality), white lights are reflected in the materials surface from the Blender scene, digital texture

a Blender render of a glossy, flesh-like surface, with red, grey, pink and black colourings. The image seems uncannily real, almost alive, and yet I can't place what it might be. It seems like the surface of the image is wet, white lights are refected in the materials surface from the Blender scene, digital texture

a Blender render of red, blue and yellow transparent vertical, slanted stripes over a patterned background. The background is black and beige, with markings like you might find on butterflies wings. Some of the coloured, slanted, vertical lines span the length of the image and some of them are short dash-like marks, digital texture

a Blender render of a high-gloss, paint-like material, with white, maroon, red, black and blue colours covering a wrinkled object. The image is a close up of what could be part of a ceramic, spherical object with a patterned, hand painted glaze, captured from above, the UV map of the image texture seams meet to form a hard line, digital texture

a Blender render of a high gloss surface, what look like dripping paint marks of black paint (outlined and highlighted with light brown marks) protrude from the left hand side and drip towards the right, the surface of the image has a snakeskin-like texture within it, with splashes of blue, purple and turquoise in the background, digital texture

a Blender render, close up image of a white, black and blue patterned, coloured insect-like thing with lots of what could be legs, or limbs, in a big pile, or mess, the surface of the object (its material) is shiny and reflective, almost glass-like, digital texture

a Blender render of a pimpled, shiny surface patterned with dark yellow, black, magenta, royal blue, cyan and white colourings, in a marked arrangement that reminds me of mould patterns (in some way), the pattern is irregular, and the white sections form highlighted marks of irregular circles that snake a path across the image, digital texture

a screenshot image, taken on a smartphone, of a digital scene made in three.js, geometric lines and arcs cut the image up into smaller sections and form the composition, which is coloured a smokey, glassy, greyish blue, with smaller areas to the upper right in red, and towards the bottom right in purple, the colouring is desaturated and feels smooth, digital texture

a Blender render of a black and grey patterned surface that has a line-like, soft-edged geometric pattern cut into it, the surface is glossy and textured in a way that resembles the wrinkled effect that forms within the skin that forms on a pot of paint if it has been left open, digital texture

a digital image containing a bold, graphic pattern of high contrast bright colours of blue, green, red, purple, yellow and light brown markings on a black background, the image is chaotic and the style resembles that of an old cathode ray TV image, digital texture

a Blender render of a close up of an object's patterned surface, the object could be a snake, judging by how it is patterned, but it is digital and so obviously isn't, the image appears to be made up of 2 or 3 different layers and so has a depth to it, the first layer, in the foreground, consists of 2 parallel lines of dark grey, irregular dashes that have a light grey outline, these split the image in 2 as they run diagonally from the top right hand side of the image to the bottom left hand side, other markings of a similar style, but in a more haphazard arrangement, positioned in the bottom right hand quarter of the image, complete the foreground layer, the background of the image contains irregular cross hatched light and dark grey marks on the left hand side of the image, with a black area mirroring the foreground dashes slightly offset to the left, blurred areas of red, pink, green and blue colours sit towards the right hand half of the image, with lines that resemble geographic topological mapping in the bottom right hand corner, digital texture

a screenshot captured on a smartphone of a three.js scene, the main content of the image appears to be liquid like material, judging by the highlighted, patterned reflections on its surface, these parts are dark grey, light grey and white, with areas tinted in blues, purples and greens, there is a red section in the foreground of the image that sits in contrast to its surroundings, its irregular form, shadowed with dark red and darker areas of black, spans the majority of the bottom third of the inner rectangle, digital texture

a Blender render of a mesh like surface, which has the appearance of a moire, or digital interference pattern affected by red, blue and green overlaid and overlapping finely woven grids, the image has folded creases within it and reflects the light in the Blender scene (as if the material is a shiny fabric of some kind), irregular shaped areas around the left hand side of the image, and in the bottom right of the image, are black, digital texture

a screenshot captured on a smartphone of a web application made in three.js, the image contains lots of sausage-like marks of different scales and colours, all of which determines how they are perceived within the picture space, within the inner rectangle, a close up image of bubble wrap plastic recedes into the background, these are shaded with deep red and light blue hues at opposite ends of the colour spectrum, black and red jagged shapes appear to sit on a middle plane, with maroon worm-like patches of colour positioned in the foreground, digital texture

a Blender render of a mesh-like surface, which has the appearance of a moire, or digital interference pattern affected by red, blue and green overlaid and overlapping finely woven grids, the image has bubbling creases within it and reflects the light in the Blender scene (as if the material is a shiny plastic sheeting of some kind), irregular shaped black areas jut in from the right hand side of the image, and bleed horizontally towards the centre, digital texture

a Blender render of a fleshy grey and pink object shot close up, the object looks like it could be some kind of sea creature, it appears slimy and wet and reflects the light in the Blender scene through its glossy surface, there is a symmetry to the texture mapped around the digital object, although this symmetry is reflected off centre within the image itself, digital texture

a Blender render of a slimy, fleshy digital object that makes you feel like you want to touch it, the image glows through light pink and light grey hues, almost as if it is backlit, there is a symmetry to the digital objects form that is also reflected in the symmetry of the image texture that is wrapped around it, small intricate worm-like marking and textures are dotted over the image, areas within the top left hand side and bottom right hand side of the image are darker in colour, with bright red and dark maroon tones making the image recede in these areas, digital texture

a Blender render of an awkward shaped digital object that feels like it is invading the camera frame in an unwanted way, it is patterned with pink, brown, orange, green and white tones that are overlaid with white and black markings that look like they have been applied through a mesh like stencil, the surface of the image is uneven and shiny and reflects the white light within the scene, digital texture

a Blender render of a sculpted digital object, shot close up, the object's material is smooth and shiny and reflects the white light in the scene and elements of the HDRI image wrapped around the Blender world space (which reveals itself as greenish parts within the image), the object is wrapped in a black, white and grey striped texture, smaller blue, red and pink areas reveal themselves on closer inspection, the object appears closer to the camera in the centre of the image, and recedes away from the camera towards the edges, digital texture

a Blender render close up of a snakeskin like material, split into two parts by a diagonal line across the image, the top section is coloured green, dark grey and light grey, whilst the lower section is coloured blue, white, red and grey, a curved column resembling a spinal cord pattern splits the top section diagonally in two, the arc of the spine continues through the lower section in a less visually obvious way, the material is glossy and reflects the light of the Blender scene, digital texture

a Blender render of a black and white fish-eye pattern, which sits below the surface of a translucent flesh coloured digital object sculpted to resemble a sea creature, the translucent surface of the object is tinted with pink tones in areas that cover about ten percent of the image in total, the surface of the digital object is smooth and slippery and glistens as it reflects light, two finger like forms within the object meet almost halfway up the image three quarters of the way across, digital texture

a Blender render close up of a snakeskin markings which sit below the surface of a translucent glistening skin, this subsurface pattern is split into two parts by a diagonal line across the image, the top section of the subsurface is coloured green, with hints of blue and purple, whilst the lower section is colored indigo with hints of red, a shadow falls within the image vertically up its centre, the shape of the shadow is curved and organic and wider at the bottom than it is at the top, the material is glossy and reflects the light, digital texture

a Blender render of a surface textured like the ocean but patterned with different blocks of irregular coloured shapes each of which is outlined and highlighted in a medium weighted light-grey line, the shapes tessellate loosely across the image, the pattern almost resembles area of land on a map of the earth's surface, the shapes are coloured dark-green, grey and a pinkish-orange colour, whilst the areas between the shapes are mainly black and greenish, the surface of the digital material is glossy and reflects the whites light of the Blender scene, digital texture

a Blender render of a thick, viscous substance made up of a multicoloured, glossy material that reflects the white light within the Blender scene, the digital substance waves across the image with stripes and patches of greens, blues and purples, digital texture

a Blender render of a viscous material, whose form is liquid and whose texture is solid, the image the material is textured with is off-white, royal blue and black, and resembles a distorted, loosely woven grid or net, the marks denoting the grid lines are thick and wavy, the material is shiny and wet and reflects the white light in the Blender scene, digital texture

a Blender render of a high-gloss, metallic paint like material, with pastel pinks and blues, maroon, red, black and blue colours covering a wrinkled object. The image is a close up of what could be part of a ceramic, spherical object with a patterned, hand painted glaze, the object has been captured from above, the UV mapped image textures seams meet to form a hard line, digital texture

a Blender render of a deflated spherical object made from a shiny, viscous material that reflects the light in the Blender scene, the image is split into three different coloured areas, the main area takes up roughly three quarters of the image, it is mainly a mid-grey tone, with highlights of multi-coloured markings that pattern it's ripply, wavy surface, an off-white area protrudes from the top-left corner of the image in the shape of the bottom-right quadrant of a circle, its texture is consistent with the image as a whole, but it's markings are light blue (they look like they have been lightly brushed on), the third and final section is darker in colour, and located in the bottom left-hand corner of the image, its shaped like the upper-right quadrant of a circle, it's dark grey background is coloured with red, magenta and navy blue markings, digital texture

a Blender render of a rippled, viscous object that has been textured to look like a glazed ceramic, its material is glossy and wet looking and reflects the lights in the Blender scene, the ripples within the object are less tight towards the right hand side of the image, they tighten towards the left hand side, making the image look like it recedes backwards, the object is loosely coloured with grey, black, red and maroon tones on the right hand side of the image, the left edge (where the tightly-rippled areas are), are coloured in different shades of light browns, digital texture

a Blender render of a surface textured like the ocean but patterned with markings that look like they could have been taken from a Whistler painting, they are moody and give the effect of a Winters scene, the upper right hand corner of the image is a deep purple, fading into an off-white lower down, the lower half of the image is coloured in darker blacks, reds and petrol colours that look as if they could have been pawed on by an animal, a dark patch of blackish red colour bleeds into the left half of the image from the left-hand edge, the surface of the digital material is glossy and reflects the white lights of the Blender scene, digital texture

a Blender render of a sculpted digital object, shot close up, the object's material is smooth and shiny and reflects the white light in the Blender scene, it is patterned with different blocks of irregular coloured shapes most of which are outlined and highlighted in a medium weighted light-grey line, the shapes tessellate loosely across the image, they are coloured dark-green, grey and a pinkish-orange colour, whilst the areas between the shapes are mainly black and a greenish-blue, the texture ripples in on itself in the upper right hand corner of the image making the image pattern more chaotic and more difficult to make out, digital texture
